classes.name: GeomTools
classes.summary:
The {@link GeomTools | `GeomTools`} package provides utilities for Geometry.
- SurfaceSet, CurveSet, Curve2dSet : Tools used for dumping, writing and reading.
- Methods to dump, write, read curves and surfaces.

classes.name: GeomTools_Curve2dSet
classes.summary: Stores a set of Curves from Geom2d.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Returns an empty set of Curves.

instanceMethods.name: Clear
instanceMethods.comment: Clears the content of the set.

instanceMethods.name: Add
instanceMethods.comment: Incorporate a new Curve in the set and returns its index.
